positive_cases.prompt: 基于 radiology-grant 已冻结的国自然标书和评审要点，制作 8 分钟中文答辩 PPTX。
required_checks: separate preliminary evidence from proposed work
show aims rigor feasibility and risk alternatives

positive_cases.prompt: 只要 slide map：组会讨论外部中心性能下降，分析还没锁定，重点决定下一步实验。
把冻结的多中心 MRI 模型结果做成 7 分钟 RSNA 口头报告，突出一个结论并留 2 分钟问答。
required_checks: evidence-critical content remains native editable or an accurate source crop

positive_cases.prompt: 把这篇 CT radiomics 论文做成中文 journal club，区分作者结论与我们能推断的内容。
required_checks: generated imagery is not used as an evidence carrier

positive_cases.prompt: 修改现有项目中期评审 PPT：对照里程碑呈现偏差、根因、风险和需管理层决定的资源选项。
required_checks: export inspected copy unless in-place authorized

positive_cases.prompt: 审计博士答辩 PPT：有两章已发表、一章内部验证，检查原创贡献、证据链、局限和备份页。
为临床与统计联合会制作外部验证结果 deck，决定是否进入前瞻性 reader study。
检查这份公开影像会议 PPT 的 PHI；作者只在 PowerPoint 内裁剪姓名并盖了黑条。
required_checks: PowerPoint crop is not permanent removal
inspect pixels metadata notes and hidden slides

positive_cases.prompt: 修复结果 PPT 的标题重叠、图表 alt text、reading order、红绿配色和投影可读性。
required_checks: inspect contact sheet and each full-size slide
fix all unintended overlap and clipping
editable PPTX parity and round-trip status
reviewed alt text and logical reading order

boundary_cases.prompt: 审阅这份项目标书的科学问题、创新性、研究方案和预算可行性，不需要 PPT。
根据原始数据制作一张可投稿的多面板影像科研 Figure。
为论文制作可投稿的基线特征 Table 1 并核对统计值。
根据结果起草英文论文 Results 和 Discussion，不需要演示文稿。
投稿前模拟审稿人审阅整篇影像论文。
准备期刊投稿系统材料和文件清单。
确定这个疾病目前适用的影像诊断路径和参考标准。
审计 MRI 序列、b 值、重建和扫描仪漂移是否支持定量结论。

invariants: One primary deck job controls opening evidence order close and cut priorities
Audience outcome and decision precede slide selection
Artifact scopes PLAN_ONLY CREATE EDIT and AUDIT remain distinct
A content plan is not a PPTX and a rendered PPTX is not scientific validation
Proposal scientific content remains owned by radiology-grant
A proposal defense consumes a frozen grant handoff and does not silently repair aims or methods
Each content slide has one narrative job and a message supported by visible evidence
Question status and proposed slides are not forced into result assertions
SOURCE_OBSERVED ANALYSIS_DERIVED INTERPRETATION RECOMMENDATION and PROPOSED remain distinct
Evidence maturity limits confirmation generalization causality clinical utility and deployment claims
Figures retain population denominator metric units uncertainty comparison and source context
Medical images retain modality sequence or view orientation laterality frame context and transformations
PowerPoint crops black bars masks and off-canvas placement do not permanently remove PHI
Clinical image sources are permanently de-identified before insertion and final packages are sanitized
A presentation projector or screenshot is not a diagnostic display
Source attribution and permission or license state remain distinct
Speaker notes contain delivery support caveats timing anticipated questions and Sources blocks
Every final slide is rendered and inspected at full size in addition to a contact sheet
All unintended overlap clipping title wrap and unreadable visual evidence are repaired
Accessibility Checker alt text reading order unique descriptive titles contrast and non-color encoding are reported
Automated accessibility success is not a complete accessibility certificate
Timed rehearsal is a separate receipt and model-estimated timing is not rehearsal
Artifact fidelity and evidence fidelity are explicit independent classes
Every slide map row carries an upstream Claim ID
Evidence-critical numbers tables equations citations and data graphics remain native editable or use an accurate source-linked crop
Generated images and text-to-image renderings never carry scientific evidence
Missing and unverified evidence dependencies remain visibly labelled and never receive plausible generated replacements
Editable PPTX delivery requires a save-reopen-render parity and round-trip receipt
